description: Grants the remotely-hosted Orcaa PWA access to the native notification commands. The wrapper never loads a local page — the webview always sits on an https://*.orcaa.cloud origin — and Tauri denies EVERY IPC call coming from a remote origin unless that origin is listed in a capability's `remote.urls`. Without this file `plugin:notification|notify` is rejected and OS toasts silently never fire. Kept separate from `default.json` (which stays local-only) so the remote page gets notifications and nothing else.
